title: BBG Cunningham Econ
tagline: The removal pile defining the format. The best Towerfall shell, the only viable event-based removal, and a draw engine that does not stop.

title: GRY Trauma Team
tagline: Three colours, one of each Legend: a midrange pile built around Trauma Team Operatives and the best cards of each colour.

title: Rainbow Fixer Stuff
tagline: Three colours of good commons and nothing else. Almost no rares, no real top end, and still a functional deck -- which is the point.

title: RRB Wakako Midrange
tagline: The same red beatdown shell traded down a stat line for a stun package. Lizzy Wizzy replaying Programs from the trash is the tempo engine.

title: RRG Dexter Midrange
tagline: A curve of oversized bodies backed by double-red interaction. The green splash exists almost entirely to push Yorinobu and Adam Smasher to 10 power.

title: RRY Smasher Aggro
tagline: Red aggro with a yellow splash: cheap Units on curve, Gear to push them through, and Adam Smasher to close.

title: YYB Rogue Gear
tagline: A Gear-heavy yellow deck: Units that get better with every piece of chrome, and Rogue turning each fight into Gigs.
